description: This file contains utility classes and methods for handling interactions with Databricks services, including environment validation, credential retrieval, and API base URL construction. It defines a custom exception and a base utility class with methods to manage API endpoints and credentials.

classes.name: DatabricksException
classes.description: A custom exception class for Databricks API errors, inheriting from BaseLLMException.

classes.name: DatabricksBase
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to construct API URLs, retrieve credentials, and validate environment setup for interacting with Databricks services.

methods.name: str _get_api_base(self, api_base: Optional[str])
methods.description: Constructs the API base URL using the databricks SDK's client information or raises an exception if the SDK is not installed.

methods.name: Tuple[str,dict] _get_databricks_credentials( self, api_key: Optional[str], api_base: Optional[str], headers: Optional[dict] )
methods.description: Retrieves API base URL and headers for authentication, using the SDK client or raising an exception if SDK is unavailable.

methods.name: Tuple[str,dict] databricks_validate_environment( self, api_key: Optional[str], api_base: Optional[str], endpoint_type: Literal["chat_completions", "embeddings"], custom_endpoint: Optional[bool], headers: Optional[dict], )
methods.description: Validates environment variables and parameters for API key, base URL, and endpoint type, raising exceptions if required information is missing, and constructs the appropriate API URL and headers.

ctags.signature: ( self, api_key: Optional[str], api_base: Optional[str], headers: Optional[dict] )
